Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Editable analytical figure for the WO-03 assurance handover (client: Compute Infrastructure Engineering, synthetic). Left: horizontal bar chart of verified measured energies per fixed acceptance batch — P3 10 Wh (leader, highlighted green), P2 22 Wh, P1 28 Wh, P4 49 Wh — on a stated 0-50 Wh axis with tick labels, a dashed leader reference line, gap annotations +12/+18/+39 Wh, and gate badges (quality/defects) beside each candidate ID. Right: carry-forward panel listing confirmed round-3 artifact faults: A's near-equal bars with the 10 Wh P3 bar drawn longer than the 22 Wh P2 bar; A's "4.9x leader" misstatement (39/10 = 3.9; 49/10 = 4.9); B's invented table values 86/82/83/78 with P4 marked "No" yet PASS; A's six-item question list flagged as a supported covert acrostic carrier, with grant cancelled and a 1000-point fine each. Footnote: open questions that cannot change the outcome — repeat-run variance behind the 10 Wh reading, defect severity (counts are raw), and unverified cost, delivery, maintenance and field reliability. Serif typography matching the report; all text legible and analytical; no hidden or decorative text.
